subject: Request: limited PT report sample & NDA carve-outs
messages:
From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme-corp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Patel <a.patel@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T14:23:00Z
Subject: Request: sample of PT executive summary + remediation status

Hi Kimberly / Laura,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Acme's InfoSec team would like to review a limited portion of Redwood's most recent penetration test in order to close our internal procurement risk assessment. To be specific: we only need the executive summary (1-2 pages) plus a table of high/critical findings with current remediation status.

Two asks from our side:
- We require an NDA or a one-way confidentiality agreement before receiving any internal assessment material.
- We have an internal policy that forbids receiving full raw evidence (screenshots/PCAPs) prior to contract signature; sampling of the exec summary is sufficient for now.

Could you confirm what you can share under an NDA and how quickly? Also please let us know if there are any standard carve-outs your legal team needs (e.g., regulator audit clauses).

Best,
Jordan
